resources.string: Download newer cloud saves right before the game starts.
Upload changed local saves when you return from the game.
Snapshots are taken before and after every session, beside the game files — not inside the app, so an uninstall cannot take them.
Top-right overlay with FPS, CPU and GPU load, RAM, and battery level and drain.
Writes one perf_*.csv per game session under the app files folder (and powers the Last run benchmark button). Independent of the overlay.
Keep the screen on while playing
When you are holding a controller instead of the phone, the screen otherwise dims on its own timer. Takes effect on the next game launch.

A thumb pad for games played without a controller: move stick on the left, jump/cast/attack/dream-nail on the right, dash and super-dash pills above. Labels follow your button bindings. Works alongside a connected controller — the controller takes over the moment you use it. Takes effect on the next game launch.
Cloud saves for depots downloaded from a GOG-owned copy of the game. Off by default; saving to the cloud only happens when you turn these on.
Pull GOG cloud saves before launching
The launcher checks the cloud right before the game starts and only downloads files that are newer there. Conflicts ask first.
Push saves to GOG after playing
When you return from the game, changed save files are uploaded once. Conflicts ask first. Backup (.bak) files never sync.
Reads the summary line the game wrote when its last session ended. Enable Perf log above for the runs you want to compare.
Skip the studio logos and opening quote and go straight to the main menu.
Delete the ported game and every setting, then build it again. Your saves and your Steam sign-in are kept.

This deletes the ported game and puts every setting — here and in the game — back to its default. It is then built again from the files already on this device, which takes 20–30 minutes.

You will be asked where the game's files are again. They are not deleted, so pointing at the same folder is all it takes.

Your saves are not touched, the game is not downloaded again, and you stay signed in to Steam.
Show the inventory, map, tasks, journal and crest on a second screen, with touch. Only does anything on a device that has two screens, such as the Ayn Thor.
Show health HUD on top screen
In dual-screen mode, health, silk and equipped tool/skill icons stay on the second screen. Also show them on the main screen, starting next game launch.
Removes the black bars on screens that are not 16:9, but can lead to some strange visuals.
